4050-8304--73.manaNeeded: {1} if all three of the persist or undying creatures have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on them respectively
4050-8304--73.description:
If any of the creatures with persist or undying do not have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on them respectively, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1 until all three persist or undying creatures have a counter on them.
Activate Data by paying {1} and removing a counter from each of the persist or undying creatures, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6794-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist

2438-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2438-7936--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

431-851-3129-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-3129-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4890-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4890-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dack's Duplicate and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4890-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

341-1090-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-4785-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-4785-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-4785-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

1619-2921-4605-5542-6148.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6148.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Seasoned Dungeoneer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Seasoned Dungeoneer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Seasoned Dungeoneer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6148.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

67-4053-5147-7410.description:
Cast Rhys by paying {1}{W}
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rhys.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, its ability and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rhys from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

104-2034-4365-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-2034-4365-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

911-5686-6972--112.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
911-5686-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

654-1671-5451-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
654-1671-5451-5702.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters, Amulet of Vigor, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

224-1772-3257-6763.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{R}.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

586-2292-3168-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2842-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2842-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

132-198-549-4018.notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-198-549-4018.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {U} or {B} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Merrow Grimeblotter's ability by paying {1}{U/B} and untapping it, giving target creature -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

575-2034-5318.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Forest.
575-2034-5318.description:
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kamahl's first ability by paying {G}, causing the Forest to become a 1/1 creature until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Forest, adding {C}{C}.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest land from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Repeat.

2011-2718-4214.notablePrerequisites: Pollenbright Wings attached to a creature with power five or greater that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2011-2718-4214.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Pollenbright Wings attached.
Pollenbright Wings triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability five times by sacrificing five Saprolings, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If the creature has power six or greater and/or a Warrior you control can attack, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.

643-1099-3413.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-1099-3413.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing a creature, which is a Goblin due to Maskwood Nexus.
The creature dies as a Human due to Maskwood Nexus, triggering Xathrid Necromancer, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve all Sling-Gang Lieutenant abilities, causing any number of target player(s) to lose infinite life and you to gain infinite life.

3169-4404-4598-4659-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Essence Flux without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Corridor Monitor.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Genesis Chamber.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

528-5035.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total among all players.
528-5035.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin, paying at least as much life as the opponent with the highest life total has.
Resolve Plague Vermin, creating an amount of Rats equal to the amount of life you paid.
Corpse Knight triggers for each Rat, causing each opponent to lose 1 life for each Rat.

2178-4096-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Goblin Welder.
You control a nontoken artifact creature.
Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4096-4840.description:
Tap Goblin Welder, targeting the artifact creature on the battlefield and Myr Battlesphere in your graveyard.
The artifact creature is sacrificed and Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield.
Goblin Welder triggers, untapping itself.
Myr Battlesphere triggers.
creating 4 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Welder again, targeting the artifact creature in your graveyard and Myr Battlesphere on the battlefield.
The artifact creature returns to the battlefield and Myr Battlesphere is sacrificed.
Goblin Welder triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

411-2146-2520.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Skyshroud Elf by paying {1}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
